blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) on Thursday lifted its hours-long ban on Discord after the platform committed to cooperate with Philippine authorities on online child safety measures. The ban was issued after authorities said Discord has servers related to Nihilistic Violent Extreme (NVE) as well as those that “groom” minors, or a Gen Z term that pertains to an act wherein an adult builds a relationship with a minor, who will be at risk of abuse.
